CustomField.description: Provides a visual lifecycle status indicator derived from the animal's current status.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(Current_Status__c), "Pending Intake", "Amber - Pending intake", "In Care", "Green - In care", "Exited Care", "Blue - Exited care", "Deceased", "Grey - Deceased", "Grey - Not set" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Derived automatically from Current Status for quick operational context.
CustomField.label: Lifecycle Signal
